# telnyx_10dlc_brand_external_vetting_import (Action)

Imports an existing vetting record from a vetting provider approved by The Campaign Registry into a 10DLC brand. Once the provider confirms the record, it counts toward the brand's campaign qualification.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `brand_id` (String) The brand id.
- `evp_id` (String) External vetting provider ID for the brand.
- `vetting_id` (String) Unique ID that identifies a vetting transaction performed by a vetting provider. This ID is provided by the vetting provider at time of vetting.

### Optional

- `vetting_token` (String) Required by some providers for vetting record confirmation.
